stage0037_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Neo Zeon's pursuit unit, incoming...!」

stage0037_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$オットー$$
「If they could send something like that,
　they should've used it at Palau, why now...!」

stage0037_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$オットー$$
「The enemy's numbers aren't that great!
　Launch every unit on our side too!」

stage0037_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$フラスト$$
「Still, I wonder what Colonel $$フロンタル$$ is thinking.
　Chasing $c with just this many...」

stage0037_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$アレク$$
「No matter how short on firepower we are,
　fitting the transport $$ガランシェール$$ with the
　Skiure Cannon dragged from a Palau warehouse...」

stage0037_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Our real job
　is the mission Commander $$ハマーン$$ gave us:
　rescuing the Princess」

stage0037_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Think of it as lucky that we can act
　where those who don't care about her won't watch」

stage0037_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「That's the way it is, $$マリーダ$$.
　That white one over there's yours」

stage0037_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「Fighting someone whose face you know is rough...」

stage0037_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Can you do this, $$バナージ$$?」

stage0037_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$バナージ$$
「But $$シン$$ said all you can do
　at a time like this is just move」

stage0037_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Come on...
　you're the senior here. Can't you give
　better advice than that?」

stage0037_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$シン$$
「It's not like I could help what I said...!」

stage0037_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$カトル$$
「That's true.
　Rather than getting stuck in a loop of doubt,
　I think that's healthier」

stage0037_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Sheesh...
　so this is how reckless hotheads get made, huh」

stage0037_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「That's enough idle chatter.
　The enemy's right in front of us」

stage0037_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Their core is an Enhanced Human's mobile suit.
　Bring it down and the rest collapses」

stage0037_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Let's go, $$バナージ$$.
　Now that you've decided to move,
　show me you can do it」

stage0037_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Please stop, Ms. $$マリーダ$$!
　What's the point of fighting any more!?」

stage0037_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Fighting you is my mission!」

stage0037_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$バナージ$$
「You people are too single-minded!
　Why won't you look for a way besides fighting!?」

stage0037_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「If there were another way,
　we'd already be doing it!」

stage0037_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Damn it... you stubborn fool!!」

stage0037_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$バナージ$$
「That mobile suit...
　is Ms. $$マリーダ$$ the one piloting it...!」

stage0037_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「So you noticed, $$バナージ$$...!」

stage0037_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Please stop, Ms. $$マリーダ$$!
　What's the point of fighting any more!?」

stage0037_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Fighting you is my mission!」

stage0037_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$バナージ$$
「You people are too single-minded!
　Why won't you look for a way besides fighting!?」

stage0037_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「If there were another way,
　we'd already be doing it!」

stage0037_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Damn it... you stubborn fool!!」

stage0037_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$アルベルト$$
（Reacting to that Enhanced Human's hostility,
　the NT-D system activated...!）

stage0037_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「So you've shown your true form, Unicorn!」

stage0037_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「The $$ガランシェール$$ falls back too!
　We're recovering $$マリーダ$$!」

stage0037_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$n
「With the NT-D active, the Unicorn's
　strength is like a demon's」

stage0037_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$リディ$$
「What are you doing, $$バナージ$$!?」

stage0037_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「No...!
　That's... that Gundam's own will!」

stage0037_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$カミーユ$$, get out of there!
　$$バナージ$$'s not himself right now!」

stage0037_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$オットー$$
「Mr. $$アルベルト$$!
　What's the meaning of this!?」

stage0037_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「The NT-D has awakened its true power...」

stage0037_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「That's a machine built to kill Newtypes!
　Its fight with that four-winged
　Enhanced Human triggered the system!」

stage0037_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「And now that they've pulled back,
　it's found another Newtype and is going for the kill!」

stage0037_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$オットー$$
「What have you brought aboard!」

stage0037_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「That's why, to keep this from happening,
　I had every Federation Newtype machine
　sealed away!」

stage0037_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「It's all that four-winged one's fault!
　Her hostility fully woke the NT-D!」

stage0037_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「No good...!
　Not with the $$リゼル$$ damaged, I can't
　shake off the Unicorn now!」

stage0037_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$アポリー$$
「Can you hear me, $$カミーユ$$!」

stage0037_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$アポリー$$
「I just sent the Zeta your way on autopilot!
　Use it!」

stage0037_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$シン$$
「$$カミーユ$$, get in the Zeta!
　We'll hold $$バナージ$$ off!」

stage0037_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$アルベルト$$
（What's going on...!?
　That unit was supposed to have been sealed
　by Anaheim for the sake of the UC Plan!）

stage0037_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Get a hold of yourself, $$バナージ$$!
　Don't you know who we are!?」

stage0037_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「By the machine...
　is the Unicorn controlling your mind...!」

stage0037_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Watch out, $$カミーユ$$!
　Something's coming!」

stage0037_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$カイエン$$
「An Abductor, here of all places!」

stage0037_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Looks like its purpose is different
　from the usual kidnappings!」

stage0037_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$アルト$$
「So it's made us its target, huh!」

stage0037_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Heh... quite a lively bastard here.
　Guess I can't lose either!」

stage0037_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$カグラ$$
「What, $$ミカゲ$$!
　I've got no intention of taking your orders!」

stage0037_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That white unit's existence can't be allowed...
　Destroy it」

stage0037_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I said I don't take orders!」

stage0037_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「...Do you want to be punished again?」

stage0037_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$カグラ$$
「...Tch!
　Basically I just gotta stomp everyone
　in front of me, right!」

stage0037_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Well, that'll do.
　I'm counting on you, $$カグラ$$」

stage0037_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Can you hear me, Mechanical Angel and friends!
　Hand over my damn woman!」

stage0037_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$アマタ$$
「That guy...!
　Is he talking about $$ミコノ$$!?」

stage0037_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$カグラ$$
（Now then... if I come here like this,
　that $$ジン$$ will probably remember his mission too）

stage0037_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$カミーユ$$!
　We'll take on the Abductor!
　You stop the Unicorn!」

stage0037_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$シン$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$!
　Stopping $$バナージ$$ alone right now is reckless!」

stage0037_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's not $$バナージ$$!
　It's the Unicorn's own will!」

stage0037_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$アムロ$$
「And right now... it's after you!」

stage0037_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$オズマ$$
「I'll send what backup I can!
　Don't push yourself, $$カミーユ$$!」

stage0037_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「A machine that controls people...!
　To think such a thing still exists...!」

stage0037_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Hang on, $$バナージ$$!
　I'll stop the Unicorn and save you!」

stage0037_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Whew... for a second there I wondered
　how it'd turn out...」

stage0037_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You're all right now, $$バナージ$$?」

stage0037_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Watch yourself, $$バナージ$$.
　The NT-D will keep trying to make you
　a part of itself from here on」

stage0037_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Overcome your doubt.
　If you can't, the system
　will end up killing you」

stage0037_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I'll keep that in mind」

stage0037_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$バナージ$$
（I'll probably keep doubting from here on...
　but even so, I'll fight）

stage0037_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$バナージ$$
（As the one entrusted with the Unicorn,
　to find possibility in this world, and in myself...）

stage0037_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$フラスト$$
「Captain!
　The $$ガランシェール$$ won't hold much longer!」

stage0037_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Fall back!
　We can't leave the squad with nowhere to return!」

stage0037_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「$$マリーダ$$, don't push yourself either!
　You don't need to risk your life for a mission
　that treats you like a throwaway pawn!」

stage0037_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$マリーダ$$
（But if I take down the Unicorn here,
　the Colonel will recognize the $$ガランシェール$$ unit...）

stage0037_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$マリーダ$$
（Then Master and everyone else
　can have a better life too...!
　For that, too...!）

stage0037_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「Sorry, $$マリーダ$$...!
　The rest is up to you!」

stage0037_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$マリーダ$$
（For Master, for the $$ガランシェール$$,
　and for those who believe in Zeon's light,
　I'll bring the Unicorn down myself...!）

stage0037_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$カツ$$
「If we pin the unit down now...!」

stage0037_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$タケル$$
「After all that damage, it can still move!?」

stage0037_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$竜馬$$
「You mean it's a bottomless monster!」

stage0037_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$シン$$
「The light of 《$$時空修復$$》!
　Same light as when we gathered everyone's hearts
　and mended time and space in the $$多元戦争$$!」

stage0037_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$葵$$
（Why is that...
　It's such a strange feeling...）

stage0037_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$アマタ$$
（Looking at that light... it feels nostalgic...）

stage0037_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$シモン$$
（Do I... know it?
　That light...）

stage0037_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's the glow of the Psycoframe...!
　The power of human will!」

stage0037_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「A machine turning human will into physical force...
　So that's what that Gundam is...!」

stage0037_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$宗介$$
（That's... just like a Lambda Driver...!）

stage0037_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「$$アルベルト$$!
　Isn't the NT-D's operation limit up yet!?」

stage0037_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「N-No good!
　With the limiter released,
　it's not accounting for strain on the pilot!」

stage0037_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$リディ$$
「Then $$バナージ$$ will just stay like this...!」

stage0037_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「If the pilot dies,
　even the NT-D will stop, surely...」

stage0037_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$n
「Captain $$アムロ$$!
　Is there no way to stop the Unicorn...
　to stop $$バナージ$$!?」

stage0037_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$カミーユ$$...!
　You call out to $$バナージ$$!」

stage0037_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I've been doing that since before!」

stage0037_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$アムロ$$
「No!
　Do it through the Zeta!」

stage0037_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$アムロ$$
「If the NT-D senses a Newtype's presence,
　it should react to your will too, sent through
　the Zeta's bio-sensor!」

stage0037_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「If there's any way to call back
　$$バナージ$$'s consciousness, that's it!」

stage0037_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「There's no choice...!
　Not if it saves $$バナージ$$!」

stage0037_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Soft and warm... and strong...
　$$バナージ$$'s light...」

stage0037_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You've come to your senses, $$バナージ$$」

stage0037_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Now that you've overcome the machine,
　you should be able to wield the Unicorn's true power」

stage0037_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You took on being a test pilot because
　there was something you wanted to do with the Unicorn」

stage0037_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Something I wanted to do...」

stage0037_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$バナージ$$
（Stop the war... show humanity's potential...
　and then...）

stage0037_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「That brat...!
　He's controlling the NT-D by his own will!?」

stage0037_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$オットー$$
「Seems $$バナージ・リンクス$$ is turning out to be
　a better test pilot than you expected」

stage0037_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You can do it, $$バナージ$$?」

stage0037_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$バナージ$$
（Father, $$オードリー$$...
　I don't know what I can do, but...）

stage0037_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$バナージ$$
（I'll give shape to the potential inside me
　with this Unicorn...!）

stage0037_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Damn it!
　Why can't I beat these guys!」

stage0037_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$カグラ$$
「$$ジン$$! What do you think you're doing!
　Quit watching and deal with the small fry!」

stage0037_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Since you won't report in,
　even old man $$イズモ$$'s about to blow up!」

stage0037_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Didn't he say something, right at the end?」

stage0037_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Who knows...
　he seemed to be yelling, but I couldn't make it out」

stage0037_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$アマタ$$
（$$ミコノ$$...
　why do you look so sad...）

stage0037_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$アマタ$$
（What happened between you and him...?）

stage0037_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「The NT-D's active state maxes out at 5 minutes.
　Keep that in mind from now on, and
　time your activations carefully」

stage0037_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Is it really $$マリーダ$$
　piloting that mobile suit!?」

stage0037_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「So you noticed, $$バナージ$$!」

stage0037_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Fighting like this won't change the world!
　Why won't you understand that!」

stage0037_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「I told you already!
　That's just your logic!」

stage0037_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Stop it, $$バナージ$$!
　She's not listening to your words!」

stage0037_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$バナージ$$
「If people can't stop fighting each other,
　wars will never end either!
　I don't want that!」

stage0037_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Being right doesn't always save people!
　I told you that too, $$バナージ$$!」

stage0037_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$バナージ$$
「For now... I have no choice but to fight!」

stage0037_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「Don't hold this against me, $$バナージ$$...!
　This is a war, after all!」

stage0037_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「No hard feelings either way!
　If you're a soldier too, fight!」

stage0037_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$バナージ$$
「That ship... $$ジンネマン$$'s ship!?」

stage0037_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Unicorn...!
　Let's settle what began on Industrial 7!」

stage0037_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$ジンネマン$$!
　Are you relying on that Zeon light too...!」

stage0037_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Move it, scentless man!
　I don't have time for you!」

stage0037_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Of course!
　That damn woman is mine!」

stage0037_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Don't decide that on your own!
　$$ミコノ$$ is... $$ミコノ$$ is...!」

stage0037_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Interesting!
　So you're fired up now!」

stage0037_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Then I'll teach you!
　Just how powerless and useless you really are!」

stage0037_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Found you, damn woman!
　I came here to kill you
　with my own hands!」

stage0037_04:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I'm sorry...
　I... have to apologize...」

stage0037_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Fine, damn woman!
　I'll hear you out plenty later!」

stage0037_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$アマタ$$
「You're a member of Element!
　And he's our enemy!」

stage0037_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Gonna resist, damn woman!?
　But it's pointless, and I'll show you why!」

stage0037_04:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I... I'll fight too...!
　Together with $$アマタ$$ and the others...!」

stage0037_04:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$バナージ$$...!
　The potential I felt in you since we first met...
　I won't let it end here!」

stage0037_04:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I will stop the Unicorn, I promise!
　To save you, $$バナージ$$!」

stage0037_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$アムロ$$
「A machine that swallows human will...!
　Have you been consumed, $$バナージ$$!」

stage0037_04:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Wake up, $$バナージ$$!
　If that machine was entrusted to you,
　then master it!!」

stage0037_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$シン$$
「I don't care about Anaheim's business!
　If you won't free $$バナージ$$,
　I'll stop it even if I destroy the Unicorn!」

stage0037_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$シン$$
「Hang on, $$バナージ$$!
　We're coming to save you now!」

stage0037_04:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$リディ$$
「Damn it!
　Isn't the Gundam a symbol of Federation power!?」

stage0037_04:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$リディ$$
「Hang in there, $$バナージ$$!
　I'll stop that thing right now!」

stage0037_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「That guy now is just like I was, trapped by Zero」

stage0037_04:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Keep your heart strong...
　Human will should be able to surpass a machine...!」

stage0037_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$n!
　The Unicorn's combat power right now is
　nothing like its normal state!」

stage0037_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$n
「Even so, I can't abandon a friend...
　I can't abandon $$バナージ$$!」

stage0037_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That's right...!
　I'll analyze the data,
　so you focus on the fight, $n!」

stage0037_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$n
「Hang on, $$バナージ$$...!
　I'm paying back everything you've done for me,
　right here!!」

stage0037_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$タケル$$
「This fight isn't $$バナージ$$'s own will...!
　Then there's only one thing for us to do!」

stage0037_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$タケル$$
「Here we come, $$バナージ$$!
　We'll stop the Unicorn!」

stage0037_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$バナージ$$ helped me
　with my science homework!」

stage0037_04:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Wait for us, $$バナージ$$!
　We'll save you right now!!」

stage0037_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's go, $$鉄人$$!
　Detach the cockpit and attack!」

stage0037_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$正太郎$$
「We'll save $$バナージ$$ with our own hands!」

stage0037_04:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$キリコ$$
（An attack with no killing intent...
　Must be the machine's doing）

stage0037_04:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$キリコ$$
（Then all I have to do is stop it）

stage0037_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$モーム$$
「Master $$桂$$...!
　Let's be sure to save Master $$バナージ$$!」

stage0037_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$桂$$
「Of course, that's the plan!
　Taking a comrade's life, or having mine taken,
　I want none of either!」

stage0037_04:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$桂$$
「That's the idea, $$バナージ$$!
　We're going in a little rough!」

stage0037_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$葵$$
「Bear with me, $$バナージ$$!
　If I hold back, I'll be the one in trouble...!」

stage0037_04:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$葵$$
「But in exchange, I will save you!
　On our pride, I swear it!」

stage0037_04:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$アルト$$
「Damn it...!
　Not even the VF-25 can shake it off!?
　At this rate, $$バナージ$$'s body won't hold up!」

stage0037_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$アルト$$
「Forgive me, $$バナージ$$!
　We're out of time, so I'm not holding back
　either, I'll stop the Unicorn!!」

stage0037_04:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$甲児$$
「Stop it, $$バナージ$$!
　Can't you hear our voices!?」

stage0037_04:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$甲児$$
「Can't be helped now...!
　Grit your teeth, $$バナージ$$!!」

stage0037_04:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$甲児$$
「Even if it takes everything Mazinger's got,
　I'll stop the Unicorn!!」

stage0037_04:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Tch...!
　This ain't some blood-crazed beast,
　it's a cold-blooded killing machine...!」

stage0037_04:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Forgive me, $$バナージ$$!
　Half measures won't stop this thing!」

stage0037_04:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$赤木$$
「Wake up, $$バナージ$$!
　Where'd the guy who fought so Palau wouldn't
　become a battlefield go!?」

stage0037_04:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$赤木$$
「Don't lose to the Unicorn, $$バナージ$$!
　You can't possibly want this!!」

stage0037_04:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$カレン$$
「Strong...!
　There's not a wasted motion in anything he does!」

stage0037_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$カレン$$
「But!
　I won't accept a fight like this!」

stage0037_04:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$カレン$$
「Wake up already, $$バナージ$$!
　Are you the kind of man who loses to a machine!?」

stage0037_04:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$宗介$$
「The enemy is not $$バナージ$$...
　It is a machine built for slaughter...!」

stage0037_04:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$宗介$$
「Then I will not hold back...!
　I will detach the cockpit swiftly
　and neutralize the target!」

stage0037_04:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Wake up, $$バナージ$$!
　Can't you hear our voices!?」

stage0037_04:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$アマタ$$
「You always cared about the Unicorn, didn't you!
　Are you really going to make it a killing machine!?」

stage0037_04:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$シモン$$
「Grit your teeth, $$バナージ$$!
　It might hurt a little,
　but I'll save you for sure!」

stage0037_04:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$シモン$$
「Here I come, Unicorn!
　If you've gone berserk,
　I'll punch some sense into you!」

stage0037_04:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$シンジ$$
「$$バナージ$$...!
　You helped me during the Yashima Operation...!」

stage0037_04:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$シンジ$$
「So this time, I'll save you!
　Together with everyone from $c!」

stage0037_04:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$バナージ$$
（The Unicorn's true power... I'll master it...!）

stage0037_04:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$バナージ$$
（Whatever Laplace's Box may be,
　right now, all I can do is fight with this power
　to stop the war...!）

stage0037_04:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I'll show that the world can be changed...!
　That's my fight from here on!」
